The 1945–46 [[Belgian First Division]] was contested by 19 teams, and [[KV Mechelen]] won the championship.<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/belghist.html |title=Belgium – Final Tables 1895–2008 |publisher=The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation |last1=Ploquin |first1=Phil |last2=Nackaerts |first2=Luc |last3=Coolsaet |first3=Jeroen |access-date=16 December 2018}}</ref>
